CustomField.description: This field is created to Assign priority as per the start date
CustomField.formula: IF(Start_Date__c < TODAY() ,'Priority-High', IF(Start_Date__c == TODAY()+0, 'Priority-High', IF(Start_Date__c == TODAY()+1, 'Priority - 1', IF(Start_Date__c == TODAY()+2, 'Priority - 1', IF(Start_Date__c == TODAY()+3, 'Priority - 2', IF(Start_Date__c == TODAY()+4, 'Priority - 2','Priority--Normal'))))) )
CustomField.label: Quote-Priority
